toolSpecs.title: Load a track
toolSpecs.jtbd: Loads a local audio file (MP3/WAV/M4A/OGG/FLAC) in the visitor's browser and renders a playable waveform.

output.label: Playable waveform panel
output.description: A chip row showing file name, format and duration, above a canvas waveform with Play preview / Stop transport controls.

toolSpecs.privacyNote: The file is decoded by the browser's own Web Audio APIs on the visitor's device; nothing is uploaded.

toolSpecs.title: Shape it live
toolSpecs.jtbd: Applies speed, pitch, reverb and bass changes live with presets like Classic Slowed + Reverb, Nightcore and Daycore, plus waveform trimming.

output.label: Live settings readout
output.description: A readout line (Speed x, Pitch st, Reverb %, Bass dB, Trim range, preset name) bound to the sliders, with live preview transport when a track is loaded.

toolSpecs.privacyNote: All shaping runs through the browser's Web Audio graph on the visitor's device; no audio leaves the page.

toolSpecs.title: Render and download
toolSpecs.jtbd: Renders the adjusted audio offline and exports it as a downloadable WAV or MP3 file matching the preview.

output.label: Rendered file summary and download button
output.description: After a short offline render, a summary line (source file name, duration, format) and a Download button producing the file that matches the preview settings.

toolSpecs.privacyNote: The render is an OfflineAudioContext pass in the browser; the encoded file is handed to the visitor as a local download and never uploaded.
